content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital paypal

Stripe and PayPal offer digital payment processing, but they come with restrictions and limitations. Stripe operates in 46 countries, while PayPal can suspend accounts at any time, holding funds for up to 180 days. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy provide alternative payment processing, but they also have limitations and can lead to account suspensions. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a complete digital commerce stack, including Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, all hosted on free infrastructure like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers. This stack offers 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff, with 30-day support.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal's country restrictions leave many countries without access to their payment processing. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy's limitations can lead to account suspensions, while PayPal's account suspension policy can hold funds for up to 180 days. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) can be deployed in 48 hours and supports payment processing in restricted countries, providing a permanent structural alternative to Stripe and PayPal.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.

COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a permanent structural alternative to Stripe and PayPal, allowing creators to own and control their digital commerce stacks without relying on restricted platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe and PayPal's payment processing requires creators to rely on their infrastructure, while Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy's limitations can lead to account suspensions. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a complete digital commerce stack that allows creators to own and control their infrastructure, automate payment processing, and deliver products directly to customers, with full data ownership and no platform dependence.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Digital creators in restricted countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan can choose COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a permanent structural alternative to Stripe and PayPal. Those who value flexibility and automation can choose COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Creators who want to customize their digital commerce stack can choose COREMERCH's Complete Builder Kit ($197).
